newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Perlis Plantations in China project.
newsitem.headline: Perlis Plantations in China project.

text.p: Perlis Plantations Bhd said on Monday that its 40 percent associate company Chemquest Snd Bhd has agreed to invest in a joint venture water supply project in Benxi, Liaoning Province in China.
In a statement, Perlis said the investment would be done through Chemquest's wholly-owned Chemquest Overseas Ltd unit incorporated in the British Virgin Islands.
The investment in the project will be held through Kerry-Chemquest (Benxi) Water Co Ltd in which Chemquest Overseas will hold a 50 percent equity interest.
Kerry-Chemquest will subscribe for 70 percent equity interest in a joint venture company incorporated in China known as Kerry Benxi Water Resources Corp which will undertake the project.
The remaining 30 percent will be held by the Benxi Water Bureau of China, it said.
Kerry Benxi's proposed share capital is 106 million ringgit and its proposed 70 percent equity stake will cost 237 million Renminbi, to be financed by bank and shareholders' loans.

The project, which is estimated to cost 339 million Renminbi, involves the construction of a rock-filled dam with a 70 million cubic metre capacity reservoir. Work is scheduled to start in the third quarter of 1997 and be completed in about five years.
The concession period of the project is 50 years from start of operation, the statement said.
